summary: Light, dark & system as one control, with an icon for each, that reports the choice and can remember it.

props.name: value
props.description: The picked theme, controlled. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The theme picked on first render, uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the theme whenever it changes, and once with a remembered one. Applying it, a class or an attribute on the page, is yours to do.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Remembers the choice in `localStorage` under this key and restores it on the next visit. Leave it out and nothing is stored.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Draws the icons alone, keeping each label as its accessible name.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the track and its options.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the track. The options nest one step inside it. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks every option and dims the control.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
